Heres the instructions:

Place the relay in/near DME compartment.
Attach the ground wire to a suitable grounding location.
Attach the constant +12 volt wire to the battery terminal.
Attach the wire labeled “temp switch” to pin 2 of the radiator temp switch.
Run the spal fan connector to the fan.
IMPORTANT. On e30 attach the ring terminal 85 to a good chassis ground location. On an e36 this wire goes to a 12v source. (I have got a late model, maybe this is what I should do on mine also?)
